responsibility: This pipeline description models the N9 core when configured with 2 read ports and 1 write port. It specializes scheduling reservations and bypass rules under the REG_PORT_2R1W configuration, including the extra micro-operation structure and dependency behavior for doubleword moves, MAC/divide results, and load/store address and data forwarding, making it distinct from the 3R2W N9 model despite sharing the same architectural ISA.
